# brand-ui

> Source-owned, token-driven React component system for internal apps, dashboards, AI/chat clients, data grids, React Flow canvases and presales demos. Default look: modern enterprise SaaS, themeable to any brand. Tailwind v4 (CSS-variable tokens) + Radix + React 19.

This file is generated from `brand-ui.manifest.json` — the anti-hallucination ground truth. Never hand-edit it. For the live, queryable API use the `brand-ui` CLI (`npx @brand/cli docs <Component>`) or, when the Storybook dev server runs, the Storybook MCP at `http://localhost:6006/mcp`.

## Rules of the road

- Semantic tokens only — no raw hex outside `packages/tokens/src/themes.css`.
- `forwardRef` + spread `...props` + merge `className` via `cn()`.
- Variants via `class-variance-authority`; Radix for overlays/interaction.
- Visible focus ring on every interactive element; must read in every theme.
- One-way dependency: `tokens → ui/icons → data/ai/flow/charts/marketing/editor/blueprint`.

## Themes (3)

qlik-dark, blueprint, qlik-bright (default)

## Packages (which package for what)

- [@brand/tokens](./llms/tokens.txt) — Semantic CSS-variable themes + ThemeProvider/useTheme. (13 components, 5 hooks)
- [@brand/icons](./llms/icons.txt) — Brand/product-vocabulary icons + BrandLogo (generic glyphs use lucide-react). (31 components, 0 hooks)
- [@brand/ui](./llms/ui.txt) — Foundation + app UI (Button, Card, Dialog, Tabs, AppShell, …). (306 components, 9 hooks)
- [@brand/data](./llms/data.txt) — TanStack DataTable, FilterBar, SearchInput, FacetFilter, ColumnPicker. (5 components, 0 hooks)
- [@brand/ai](./llms/ai.txt) — ChatShell, Conversation, Message, PromptInput, Tool, Reasoning, citations. (438 components, 12 hooks)
- [@brand/flow](./llms/flow.txt) — Branded React Flow canvas, nodes, edges, controls, inspector. (23 components, 7 hooks)
- [@brand/maps](./llms/maps.txt) — MapLibre GL maps: MapCanvas, markers, popups, controls, routes, arcs, GeoJSON, clusters. (12 components, 1 hooks)
- [@brand/charts](./llms/charts.txt) — MetricCard, MetricGrid, ChartCard, ChartFrame (expand/flip/download). (124 components, 29 hooks)
- [@brand/marketing](./llms/marketing.txt) — Hero, FeatureGrid, UseCaseCard, StatsBand, CTASection, LogoStrip. (6 components, 0 hooks)
- [@brand/editor](./llms/editor.txt) — Token-themed Monaco editor: CodeEditor, DiffEditor, CodeWorkspace. (8 components, 1 hooks)
- [@brand/blueprint](./llms/blueprint.txt) — Reprographic blueprint drawing furniture (GridPaper, BlueprintSheet, …). (10 components, 0 hooks)

## Entry points

- CLI: `npx @brand/cli info` · `… search <q>` · `… docs <Component>`
- Manifest: `brand-ui.manifest.json` (machine-readable ground truth)
- Live MCP (dev): Storybook addon-mcp at `http://localhost:6006/mcp`
- Registry (copy-own): `npx shadcn@latest add <registry-url>/<item>.json`
